# 00-139-02: Auto-generated MCP tool exposure

Feature: F139 (MCP Contract Parity)

## Goal

Register MCP tools from the CLI registry so the tool surface stops drifting through manual duplication.

## Beads

- sdplab-9jfv.2

## Scope Files

- `cmd/sdp-mcp/main.go` — registry-driven server startup
- `internal/mcp/server.go` — tool registration path
- `internal/mcp/tools.go` — registry-derived exposure logic
- `internal/mcp/tools_test.go` — coverage for generated tool registration

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] MCP tool registration is driven by CLI registry truth in scope
- [ ] Tool metadata derives from the same discovery source used by `sdp help --json`
- [ ] The parity surface avoids a second handwritten tool list
- [ ] Tests cover registration and failure behavior for generated tools

## Out of Scope

- Prompt/resource parity
- Skill consolidation
